findings.message:
[P2] Preserve aggregate identity for normalized terminal output

When an upstream has already streamed text at multiple output positions, this position-only keying breaks the aggregate-terminal case. `normalizeSurplusResponsesStream` (`src/provider/surplus.ts:421-446`) streams positions 0 and 1 separately but rewrites the terminal to one id-less message at `output[0]` containing their concatenation; the map then holds `output:0:0 = "ha"` and `output:1:0 = "ha"`, so reconciling terminal `"haha"` against only position 0 treats the second part as a new suffix and emits it again (or duplicates the whole text if position 0 was absent). Preserve an aggregate or stable alias for this normalized terminal instead of replacing item identity with a single positional key.

src/chat/stream-translation.ts:80-80

summary: The reported positional deduplication case is addressed, but position-only storage duplicates aggregate terminal text for normalized multi-position responses.

evidence: The new storage and reconciliation keys use output/content positions, and both streaming and buffered Chat Completions paths use the new storage key.
The added test supplies two id-less equal-text output parts at distinct array/output positions and asserts that both are preserved as `haha`.
